count_rule.method: Prominent speed lobes propose count; intervening speed minima seed times; free timing with endpoint-constrained linear LS at every residual evaluation
count_rule.objective: Raw XYZ position squared error only; no opposition penalty
count_rule.selection: Count from nominal detector, never adjusted from fitted error; lowest RMSE successful endpoint-valid fit at that count
count_rule.initializations: Uniform base/jitter and motion seed base/jitter; at proposed K use detected-valley seed, at other K use speed-minimum slots; seed 23
count_rule.fairness: Identical target, endpoints and prescribed K. Four nonlinear timing starts versus one exact linear fixed-time solve; unequal compute. Starts depend on K; no global-optimum claim.
count_rule.scope: Two 3 s windows from the same original clip; not full-clip conversion or biological unit identification

protocol.timing_bounds: For each boundary, r=min adjacent lobe widths (edge: one width). Onset in [left-.45r,left+.20r]; completion in [right-.20r,right+.45r], clipped to crop. Four starts seed23. Positions via endpoint-constrained linear LS for each trial time.
protocol.reason: Associate one component with each detected speed lobe; optimize timing locally with overlap. These are explicit heuristic association bounds, not inferred physiological limits.
protocol.objective: Raw position squared error; no opposition penalty
protocol.count_sweep: Repeat detector with prominence from .01 to .40, fixed 17-sample smoothing and .15 s separation; each unique valley partition is fitted. Uniform controls at same K. Different K also changes detected partition; not a pure K-only causal comparison.
protocol.failure_policy: Keep failed starts and missing fits; nominal prominence .10 is not retuned to minimize error.

detection.rule: One speed lobe per retained prominent peak, interior boundaries at lowest sample between adjacent peaks; crop endpoints cover edges; no peaks falls back to K=1
